method: Independent line-anchored lexical fn inventory plus direct source review; source definitions only, no generated functions, closures, or doctest-generated main. All direct .response_of calls are reviewed TaskSet receivers. No ai-architect graph output used.

schema.functions: Explicit fn definitions: file is repository-relative; line is 1-based declaration line; qualified_name includes manually reviewed impl/module; id combines file, line and qualified_name; attributes are contiguous immediately preceding attributes.
schema.response_of_callsites: Lexical direct method expressions within named functions; column is 1-based receiver position; caller_id joins functions.id. Calls inside macros/closures are included in containing named function; inside_macro_on_same_line only denotes a same-line lexical macro prefix and is not a complete macro-context classifier.
schema.response_of_callers: Distinct containing functions, keyed by source function id; joins functions.id.
schema.counts: Source denominators, not execution or coverage results.

limitations: Source inventory is not proof execution, runtime coverage, or verification of mathematical correctness.
Kani harness results not executed by this worker.
Cargo manifest includes kani files in package archive but declares no harness target; source has no module/include reference; CI has no Kani step.
Procedural derive-generated functions, anonymous closures, and rustdoc-generated functions are outside the explicit-fn denominator.
Lexical inventory is corpus-specific and is not a general Rust parser.
